name: Gearcoleco
description:
Gearcoleco is a cross-platform ColecoVision console emulator written in modern C++. It accurately simulates the Z80 microprocessor, Texas Instruments VDP graphics, and sound hardware of the 1982 ColecoVision.

Features:
- Accurate Z80 CPU and TMS9928A video display processor emulation
- Faithful SN76489 sound generator synthesis with clean audio playback
- Support for ColecoVision cartridge ROM images and BIOS files
- Configurable video scaling, scanline filters, and fullscreen display
- Full gamepad and controller mapping for standard and keypad inputs
